author: Matt Wolfe
description:
The #1 question I get asked: "How do you keep up with all the AI news?"⁠
⁠
And the honest answer..... I use a lot of AI 🤷🏻‍♂️⁠
⁠
One thing that has helped me a lot is Comet, an AI browser made by Perplexity. It's not just like if ChatGPT + Chrome had a baby, but it can ALSO actually do things for me and check off a lot on my to-do list. ⁠
⁠
I often use it to:⁠
📰 Summarize 4 different articles at once⁠
🎥 Get the key takeaways from long YouTube videos in seconds⁠
👨🏻‍💻 Organize tabs into clean workspaces⁠
👀 "See" the page I'm on so I can ask it questions with context⁠
⁠
If you want to research faster and work smarter, you need to try this. It's free to use, so check it out at perplexity.ai/comet⁠
⁠
#AI #ProductivityHacks
title: How I Make My "AI News" Videos

author: Matt Wolfe
description:
Whenever a major AI company releases a new model, you'll notice they reference these "AI benchmarks" to showcase how much smarter and better at coding, math, test-taking, etc. their model is. 

Well, in this video I expose how all of that is a bunch of bologna. 

Full video is linked here.
title: AI Companies Are Lying About How Smart Their Models Are
